guard: the shipped generic describe/invoke CLI connects a registered user-auth mesh with the normal bearer plus sentinel pair and its caller triple, without requiring static credentials or weakening the selected mesh TLS policy
command: COTAL_USER_ENDPOINT_CLI_ONLY=1 pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && COTAL_USER_ENDPOINT_CLI_ONLY=1 pnpm smoke:user-spawn:live
why: The smoke drives the repository's real bin/cotal.ts composition root against an isolated native user-auth broker, auth service, manager, registry record, login state and ordinary spawn-scoped cli actor. The CLI resolves its built dist, so the mutation command builds workspace and CLI before every run.

The mutation restores the old static-only guard. The named positive describe assertion then fails while the independently asserted manager.read and manager.admin denials remain part of the same real broker fixture.

The focused mode runs the same native setup and B1g assertions as the full user-spawn smoke, then tears down. The full suite remains the CI-registered coverage; focus exists solely to keep the mutation experiment bounded.
